{{Infobox Item |image= {{Media |Model BotW= File:BotW Royal Shield Model.png |Model TotK= File:TotK Royal Shield Model.png |Sprite BotW= File:BotW Royal Shield Icon.png |Sprite TotK= File:TotK Royal Shield Icon.png }} |caption= |pronunciation= |type= |game= BotW, TotK |other= AoC |cost= |value= |location= {{Spawn Locations}} |uses= Defense |strength= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= 55 |TotK= 55 }} |durability= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= 29 |TotK= 29 }} |comp= |sample= |theme= }} {{Term/Store|Royal Shield|Royal Shields|Series, BotW|plural}} are recurring [[Item]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Exp Game|BotW, TotK}} Royal Shields go unnamed in {{AoC}}. ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = 55 |durability = 29 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Royal Shield}} Chief among metal [[Shield]]s are the Royal Shields, whose [[Durability]] and defensive power outshine many others. Before the [[Great Calamity]], these Shields were issued to the immediate guard detail of the [[Royal Family of Hyrule]]. hey belong to the [[Royal Gear]] equipment archetype, a series of [[Weapon]]s associated with the Royal Family. Though they have an incredibly high defense, Royal Shields are considered collector's items due to their ornamentations. Being rare, there are only nine Royal Shields scattered across [[Hyrule|Hyrule Kingdom]], with a tenth in [[Master Mode]]. Of these, six are held by [[Enemy|Enemies]]. Some Royal Shields with consistent locations include: * Within a [[Treasure Chest]] under [[Sarjon Bridge]] in [[Faron Woods]] * Beneath a spiral staircase in [[Hyrule Castle (Dungeon)|Hyrule Castle]] The following [[amiibo]] have a chance to spawn a [[Treasure Chest]] containing a Royal Shield when they are scanned with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]]: * {{TLoZ Series}} Series [[Toon Zelda]] ({{TWW}}) amiibo * {{BotW}} Series [[Princess Zelda|Zelda]] amiibo A Royal Shield can be obtained as a reward from [[Selmie]] for completing the [[Shield-Surfing (Mini-Game)|Shield-Surfing]] [[Mini-Game]] with a time less than 1:30. When [[Link]] speaks to Selmie with a [[Royal Shield]] equipped, she will take note. She points out the one she has hanging up and claims it is the best Shield she has seen for [[Shield Surfing]]. Royal Shields are made of metal, and therefore conduct [[Electricity]] and attract [[Lightning]] if equipped during a [[Thunderstorm]]. They also sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], and will not burn if exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. The [[Magnesis]] Rune also works on them, allowing Link to pick up and manipulate them. {{BotW Shield Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Shield_022" |Life = 29 |GuardPower = 55 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 5 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 10 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMin = 5 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMax = 10 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 11 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 19 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMin = 11 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMax = 20 |RideBreakRatio = 1.0 |MirrorLevel = 0 |SurfingFriction = 1.0 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = 55 |durability = 29 |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = }} {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Royal Shield}} {{Stub|TotK}} Royal Shields reappear in {{TotK}}.
